partially_covered.missing: Organization information is limited to address and identifier; no modeling of legal name, contact details, or organization type.
Item details are generic; lacks properties for description, product code, unit of measure.

cq_coverage.details: Most competency questions are fully answerable using the ontology's structure (invoices, organizations, roles, items, prices, invoice details, business process assignment). However, details about organizations (CQ5) and items (CQ8) are only partially addressed due to missing descriptive attributes.

strengths: Comprehensive class/property hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT structure
Good use of functional and inverse properties
weaknesses: No General Class Axioms (GCAs) for complex role-based reasoning
Disjointness is only partial (not all sibling classes are disjoint)
Limited modeling of organization and item attributes

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Partial domain/range coverage in inverse properties (though most are present)
P7: Only partial disjointness among classes
reasoner_risks: No non-OWL2 datatypes or problematic axioms detected; Hermit/Pellet should load successfully

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Organization and Item classes with additional properties (e.g., legalName, contactPoint, itemDescription, unitOfMeasure) to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Full coverage for organization and item information questions.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add General Class Axioms (GCAs) to define complex concepts (e.g., define Buyer as an Organization with a RoleAssignment where hasAgentRole is BuyerRole).
Declare additional disjointness axioms among sibling classes (e.g., InvoiceHeader, InvoiceDetail, InvoiceSummary).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved logical clarity and error detection.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model temporal validity for roles and assignments (e.g., effective dates).
